grammar_focus: 动名词(主考:动词 + -ing 当名词用——作主语 Fishing is fun · 作介词宾语 interested in fishing · 完成式 having done 表更早发生 · 介词/连词 + 动名词连接短句 without/before/after doing)+ 常见搭配(辅考:enjoy/give up/finish + 动名词 · instead of / be afraid of + 动名词)
scene: 钓鱼是我最爱的运动,却常常一无所获、空袋回家;朋友劝我'别钓了,浪费时间'——他们不懂,我要的只是独坐孤舟、什么也不干

grammar_card.title: 把动词当名词用(动名词 -ing)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲动名词——动词加 -ing 后当名词用。它可以放句首当名词、跟在介词后面、还能把两个短句连起来。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 动名词 = 动词 + -ing,当名词用
放在句首当名词(后面 be 用单数 is)
Sitting in a boat is my real pleasure.
介词(in / on / of / without)后面用动名词
完成式 having done:比句子的动作更早发生
After having spent the morning, I went home.

specialRules.rule: enjoy / give up / finish 后面只能接动名词:enjoy reading, give up fishing
instead of / be afraid of + 动名词:instead of catching fish

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why is fishing the writer's favorite sport?
options: Because he loves sitting in a boat and doing nothing

passage: Fishing is my favorite sport. I often fish for hours without catching anything. But this does not worry me. Some fishermen are unlucky. Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and trash. I am even less lucky. I never catch anything — not even old boots. After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag. 'You must give up fishing!' my friends say. 'It's a waste of time.' But they don't realize one important thing. I'm not really interested in fishing. I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!

grammar_points.name: 动名词——动词 + -ing 当名词用(构成与识别)
动名词作主语(Fishing is fun,be 用单数)
动名词作介词宾语(interested in fishing)
动名词完成式 having done——比谓语更早发生
介词/连词 + 动名词连接短句(without/before doing)
instead of / be afraid of + 动名词(辅考)

stage5.stem: 动名词是怎么构成、当什么用的?
下面哪个是动名词(-ing 当名词用)?
动名词作主语时,后面的谓语动词一般用:
"___ is my favorite sport."(动名词作主语:钓鱼)
stage5.stem_cn: 钓鱼是我最喜欢的运动。

stage5.stem: "___ television is fun."(动名词作主语:看电视)
介词(in / on / of / without…)后面的动词要用:
"I'm interested in ___."(be interested in + 动名词:钓鱼)
"He is keen on ___ every day."(介词 on + 动名词:骑车)
动名词完成式 having done 表示的是:
options: 这个动作比句子的动作更早发生

stage5.stem: "After ___ the letter, he went out."(动名词完成式:写完之后)
"He left without ___ goodbye."(介词 without 后用动名词:说再见)
"Before ___ the room, he turned off the light."(before 后用动名词:离开)
"I enjoy ___ in bed."(enjoy 后接动名词:看书)
"Thank you for ___ me."(for 后接动名词:帮我)
下面哪个动词后面只能接动名词(不能接 to do)?
"I finished ___ my homework."(finish 后接动名词:做完作业)
instead of 后面接动词时,要用:
"She is afraid of ___ alone."(be afraid of + 动名词:独自待着)
